title: The operator-valued Schur-Agler class in infinitely many variables
summary: Motivated by a recent work of G. Knese [Canad. Math. Bull., 2026], we introduce the operator-valued Schur-Agler class in infinitely many variables, consisting of functions whose restrictions to every finite-dimensional polydisk lie in the operator-valued Schur-Agler class. We first establish an operator-valued analogue of Montel's theorem and, using it as a key ingredient, establish an Agler decomposition and a realization formula for functions in this class.
